_readme: Manual corrections applied after every fetch, so automatic updates never overwrite them. Song ids are the 'id' field in site/data/songs.json. 'exclude': ids to drop. 'patch': id -> fields to replace; 'sort' uses SEGA's official numbering before re-indexing, so a decimal like 12.5 places a song between official 12 and 13. 'add': complete song records for songs missing from both sources.
